headline: One picture, 4 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 4 different works in 3 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 4 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 0 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.001 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 9c0103a3962d on 3 works, 71dd1bc04e13 on 1 work.
The works are recorded as: Any Innovative Low Cost Model (4).
Each of the 4 works started and ended on a single day. The works are spread over 3 dates: 2026-05-11, 2026-05-18, 2026-05-25.
These works are spread over 3 blocks: Jandiala Guru, Majitha, Verka.
